abs-diff:
: main
  (forall ρ; ρ a:Int^many b:Int^many -- ρ r:Int^many)
  \ a-b, negated when it is below zero
  prim - dup 0 prim < [ 0 swap prim - ] [ ] if;
gcd:
: main
  (forall ρ; ρ a:Int^many b:Int^many -- ρ r:Int^many)
  over over prim =
  [ drop ]
  [ over over prim < [ over prim - ] [ swap over prim - swap ] if main ] if;

: over
  (forall ρ; ρ a:Int^many b:Int^many -- ρ a:Int^many b:Int^many c:Int^many)
  [ dup ] dip swap;
collatz-steps:
: main
  (forall ρ; ρ n:Int^many -- ρ r:Int^many)
  0 swap steps;

: steps
  (forall ρ; ρ k:Int^many n:Int^many -- ρ r:Int^many)
  dup 1 prim =
  [ drop ]
  [ [ 1 prim + ] dip dup even? [ 0 swap half ] [ 3 prim * 1 prim + ] if steps ] if;

: half
  (forall ρ; ρ k:Int^many n:Int^many -- ρ r:Int^many)
  dup 0 prim = [ drop ] [ 2 prim - [ 1 prim + ] dip half ] if;

: even?
  (forall ρ; ρ n:Int^many -- ρ r:Bool^many)
  dup 2 prim < [ 0 prim = ] [ 2 prim - even? ] if;
